checklist.title: Tourist tax rises to 16 percent in 2027
checklist.detail: The tourist tax is 12.5 percent of the room price in 2026. On 23 September 2026 the city executive agreed one rate of 16 percent of the overnight price for 2027, and the city council passed the 2027 budget with it on 12 November 2026. The city's tax page still shows the 2026 rate.
checklist.check: For any night in 2027, ask whether the quoted price already includes the 16 percent tourist tax.

sources.quote: Het college van B en W stemt in met de eerste wijzigingsverordening Toeristenbelasting 2024, waarmee in 2027 een uniform tarief van 16% van de overnachtingsprijs gehanteerd wordt.
Tourist tax: 12.5% of the overnight price (excluding VAT)

checklist.title: Cruise passengers on a day stop pay a 15 euro tax
checklist.detail: Amsterdam charges a day tourist tax of 15 euros per passenger when a cruise ship offers a day visit in the city. The cruise operator pays it to the city, so it can show up in your fare or port charges.
checklist.check: If your cruise stops in Amsterdam, check your fare breakdown for the 15 euro day tourist tax.

sources.quote: As a cruise operator, you pay tourist tax if you offer day visits to cruise passengers within the municipality of Amsterdam.
Day tourist tax: €15 per passenger

checklist.title: A legal holiday rental shows a registration number
checklist.detail: Anyone renting a home to tourists in Amsterdam needs a registration number and a permit, and must put the number in the listing. The host rents the whole home, is not there during your stay, and can take at most 4 guests. The limit is 30 nights a year per home.
checklist.check: Before you book an apartment, look for the registration number in the listing and skip it if your group is more than 4 people.

sources.quote: If you want to rent out your home or houseboat to tourists, you need a registration number and a holiday rental permit.
Vermeld het registratienummer in uw advertenties en geef het door aan verhuurplatforms zoals Booking en Airbnb.
U verhuurt aan maximaal 4 personen per verblijf.
U verhuurt uw woning of woonboot maximaal 30 nachten per kalenderjaar.

checklist.title: Central rentals get only 15 nights a year, so bookings can be cut
checklist.detail: Since 1 April 2026 homes in parts of the centre and De Pijp, including the Jordaan, the canal ring areas and Oude Pijp, may be rented to tourists for only 15 nights a year. A host who already used those nights may not rent for the rest of the year and has to change or cancel bookings that break the rule.
checklist.check: If your rental is in the Jordaan, the canal ring or Oude Pijp, read the cancellation terms and keep a backup option.

sources.quote: In een aantal wijken in het Centrum en de Pijp mag u uw woning vanaf 1 april 2026 nog maar 15 nachten per jaar verhuren aan toeristen.
Uw reserveringen passen niet meer binnen de regels. Pas deze aan of annuleer ze.

checklist.title: You cannot pay cash on Amsterdam trams
checklist.detail: GVB trams and buses do not take cash. Only a tram conductor sells tickets on board, and night bus and night tram drivers do not sell them at all.
checklist.check: Bring a contactless debit or credit card, or buy your GVB ticket before you board.

sources.quote: Night bus or tram drivers do not sell cards. You can only purchase a card from a tram conductor. It is not possible to pay with cash, so make sure you can pay using a debit card or credit card.

checklist.title: GVB day tickets do not work on NS trains
checklist.detail: GVB paper tickets are valid only on GVB trams, buses, metro and ferries. They are not valid on other carriers such as NS, which runs the trains, and you still have to check in and out with them.
checklist.check: If you plan a train trip, such as to Schiphol, budget for a separate NS ticket or use your bank card.

sources.quote: These tickets are only valid in our vehicles, so they may not be used with other public transport carriers, such as Connexxion, EBS or NS.
To make a paper card a valid ticket, you still need to check in and check out.

checklist.title: The City Card does not cover the airport trip
checklist.detail: Travel between Schiphol and the city is not included in the I amsterdam City Card. Trains run eight times an hour to Central Station and take about 17 minutes. On bus 397 the driver takes cards only, not cash.
checklist.check: Plan and pay for your airport transfer separately from any City Card.

sources.quote: Travel to and from the airport is not included in the I amsterdam City Card
Trains run eight times an hour between Schiphol and Amsterdam Central Station
from the bus driver (debit or credit card only

checklist.title: No pub crawls, no street drinking, bars close at 2 AM
checklist.detail: Pub crawls are banned in Amsterdam, and bars in the historic centre close at 2 AM. Drinking alcohol or smoking cannabis in the public area of the city centre is forbidden. Fines for nuisance run from 100 euros to 650 euros.
checklist.check: Do not book a pub crawl or plan to drink outside in the centre.

sources.quote: No pub crawls: pub crawls are prohibited to maintain a peaceful atmosphere in our neighbourhoods
drinking alcohol and smoking cannabis is forbidden in the public area of the city centre. It can lead to fines.
Fines for nuisance vary from € 100,- to € 650,-.

checklist.title: Red Light District tours are not allowed
checklist.detail: The city says guided tours are not permitted in the Red Light District. Any guided tour in the centre may have at most 15 people, may run only from 8 AM to 10 PM, and must not pass sex workers' windows.
checklist.check: Skip any tour sold as a Red Light District walk, and check that a centre tour keeps its group to 15 or fewer.

sources.quote: Guided tours are not permitted.
Guided tours in the city centre may have up to 15 participants.
Tours must not pass sex workers' windows. This also applies to groups of up to 4 people.
Tours may take place between 8 am and 10 pm.

checklist.title: Carry ID at all times or risk a 100 euro fine
checklist.detail: Anyone aged 14 or over in the Netherlands must be able to show ID. Adults who cannot are fined 100 euros. For most visitors that means your passport.
checklist.check: Plan to carry your passport or national ID card with you every day.

sources.quote: Anyone aged 14 or over must always be able to show identification.
For people aged 16 or over who fail to comply with the requirement to identify themselves, the fine is 100 euros.

checklist.title: EU border checks now take your fingerprints and photo
checklist.detail: The EU Entry/Exit System has been fully running since 10 April 2026. If you are not an EU citizen and come for a short stay, your face and fingerprints are recorded at the border instead of a passport stamp. Checks can also happen when you leave, so allow extra time at Schiphol.
checklist.check: If you are not an EU citizen, allow extra time at the border on arrival and before your flight home.

sources.quote: The EES is fully operational across all Schengen countries since 10 April 2026.
The system will replace passport stamping with digitally recorded entries, exits or refusals of entry of non-EU nationals coming for short stays.
If you are departing the Schengen area by plane, allow extra time to reach your departure gate as EES checks may take place before boarding.

checklist.title: ETIAS is not running yet but will cost 20 euros
checklist.detail: Visa free visitors, such as US citizens, will need an ETIAS travel authorisation once it starts. The EU says it is scheduled for the last quarter of 2026, and it is not taking applications yet. The fee will be 20 euros.
checklist.check: Before a trip in late 2026 or 2027, check the official EU site to see whether ETIAS has started.

sources.quote: ETIAS is scheduled to start in the last quarter of 2026 .
is currently not in operation and no applications for travel authorisations are collected at this point.
The European Travel Information and Authorisation System (ETIAS) fee will be EUR 20 instead of the previous EUR 7.

checklist.title: Anne Frank House tickets are online only and cannot be refunded
checklist.detail: The museum sells no tickets at the door, only online for a set time slot, and it takes card payment only. Tickets cannot be exchanged or refunded, and the I amsterdam City Card gives no discount. The adult price rises to 17 euros in 2027.
checklist.check: Book only on annefrank.org and pick a time slot you are sure you can make.

sources.quote: Tickets are not sold at the door, only online. Tickets cannot be exchanged or refunded.
We only accept payments by bank or credit card.
I amsterdam Card no discount
adult (from 2027 € 17.00*)

checklist.title: Check the flat's licence on the city register before you pay
checklist.detail: Barcelona runs a public lookup of licensed tourist flats. If the address is not in it, the city says the flat is illegal. A legal flat has a Catalan Tourism Register Number (NIRTC) that must be given to you when you book and shown on a sign inside.
checklist.check: Ask the host for the NIRTC number and look up the exact address on the city tool before you pay.

sources.quote: Si la teva adreça no hi apareix, el pis que busques és il·legal.
A sign with this number must be displayed inside the property, and visitors must also be given the number when they make their booking.

checklist.title: Barcelona plans to end all tourist flat licences by 2028
checklist.detail: The City Council has decided to withdraw every holiday let licence in the city by 2028, about 10,000 flats. It says it will not issue or renew these licences.
checklist.check: If you are booking a flat for 2028 or later, keep a hotel or hostel backup and confirm the flat is still licensed close to your dates.

sources.quote: the City Council has decided to withdraw all licences for holiday lets in the city by 2028.
Barcelona will no longer issue or renew licences for the 10,000 plus tourist lets currently operating in the city, meaning that these will return to the residential market in 2028

checklist.title: Your hotel or rental must record your passport details
checklist.detail: Spanish law makes hotels, tourist flats and car hire firms register guests' ID details. The national list of data includes your document number and nationality, plus how you paid. Wait while staff register your passport, and do not leave it at reception to collect later.
checklist.check: Have your passport ready at check in and expect to give ID and payment details for every adult guest.

sources.quote: Hotels, tourist accommodation and car rental companies have a legal duty to register passport and other details of tourists who check in or collect a vehicle.

sources.publisher: Boletín Oficial del Estado (Spanish state gazette), Real Decreto 933/2021
sources.quote: e) Numero de documento de identidad. f) Número de soporte del documento. g) Tipo de documento (DNI, pasaporte, TIE). h) Nacionalidad.

checklist.title: Non EU visitors give fingerprints and a photo at the border
checklist.detail: The EU Entry/Exit System has been fully running since 10 April 2026 and replaces passport stamps for short stays. On your first entry you may need to register at a special booth, which is free.
checklist.check: Allow extra time at passport control on your first trip into Europe since April 2026.

sources.publisher: European Commission, Migration and Home Affairs
sources.quote: As of 10 April 2026 , the EES replaces the stamping of passports allowing the automatic detection of overstayers
There is no cost for EES registration. On your first visit into a Schengen country, you may be asked to register your details at a special booth

checklist.title: ETIAS is not open yet, so there is nothing to buy now
checklist.detail: The EU's new travel authorisation for visa free visitors has not started. The EU will announce the start date before launch, and applications are not yet open.
checklist.check: Check the official EU site again shortly before you travel instead of paying any website now.

sources.publisher: European Commission, Migration and Home Affairs
sources.quote: ETIAS is scheduled to start in the last quarter of 2026 . The exact start date of ETIAS will be officially communicated later this year.
No action is required from travellers at this point. The European Union will announce the specific date for the start of ETIAS before its launch.
Applications are not yet open. Apply only through the official EU website once the system is launched.

checklist.title: The 10 trip metro card does not cover the airport stations
checklist.detail: The T casual card for 10 journeys is not valid at the Aeroport T1 and T2 metro stations on line L9 Sud. A single airport metro ticket costs 5.90 euros. The Hola Barcelona travel card does include metro trips to and from the airport.
checklist.check: Buy an airport ticket or a Hola Barcelona card for the airport metro ride, not the 10 trip card.

sources.quote: Not valid at the metro stations Aeroport T1 i Aeroport T2 on line L9 Sud.
Airport ticket A metro journey including Aeroport T1 and Aeroport T2 stations. Price: €5.90
Hola Barcelona Travel Card includes metro service travel between the airport and Barcelona city centre

checklist.title: Sagrada Família tickets: official app or site, about two months out
checklist.detail: The basilica sells tickets through its official app and website, roughly two months before the visit. On the day you can only buy through QR codes around the building, and only if there is space.
checklist.check: Book your time slot on sagradafamilia.org or the official app as soon as your dates are fixed.

sources.quote: Tickets can currently be purchased roughly two months before the visit.
You can buy tickets using the direct purchase QR codes around the Basilica. Availability will be based on occupancy at the time.

checklist.title: Sagrada Família has a dress code at the door
checklist.detail: It is a Catholic church. Clothing cannot be see through, trousers and skirts must reach at least mid thigh, and swimwear is not allowed. Hats are not allowed inside except for religious, health or belief reasons.
checklist.check: Pack covered clothing for the day of your visit, especially in summer.

sources.quote: No see-through clothing. Trousers and skirts must come down to at least mid-thigh. Visitors may not enter in swimwear.

checklist.title: Park Güell is timed entry with a 30 minute window
checklist.detail: Tickets for the monumental area are sold online and give you a set entry time. You have 30 minutes after that time to get in or you lose the ticket. The general ticket is 18 euros and you cannot go back in once you leave.
checklist.check: Buy on parkguell.barcelona and plan your route so you reach the gate on time.

sources.publisher: Park Güell (official site, Barcelona City Council)
sources.quote: You have 30 minutes after the time marked on your ticket to enter the site. Once that deadline has passed, you will lose your right to enter.

sources.publisher: Park Güell (official site, Barcelona City Council)
sources.quote: once you exit, you cannot re-enter. RATES PRICES General ticket 18 €

checklist.title: Drinking in the street can cost you 30 to 1,500 euros
checklist.detail: Under the city's coexistence bylaw, in force since 15 February 2026, drinking from glass bottles or cans where it is not allowed costs 30 to 100 euros. Drinking near children or in night noise zones can reach 1,500 euros, and organising pub crawls up to 3,000 euros. Alcohol cannot be sold between 10 pm and 8 am.
checklist.check: Drink in bars and restaurants, and buy any alcohol before 10 pm.

sources.quote: Consuming alcoholic beverages in glass bottles or cans in public spaces where it is not authorised. From €30 to €100
consumption of alcohol in places where minors are present, up to 1,500 euros; prohibition of pub crawls, up to 3,000 euros
Sales are restricted to over 18s and are not allowed between 10 pm and 8 am. Organising or taking part in pub crawls is also prohibited.

checklist.title: Buying from street sellers can get you fined up to 600 euros
checklist.detail: The fine applies to the buyer, not only the seller. It covers goods and also food or drinks bought from unlicensed street sellers.
checklist.check: Buy souvenirs, drinks and snacks only from shops, bars and licensed stalls.

sources.quote: Purchasing or acquiring products from unauthorised street hawkers in a public space. Up to €600
Purchasing or acquiring food or drinks from an unauthorised street hawker in a public space. Up to €600
Buying from unauthorised street vendors is illegal

checklist.title: No smoking on the beach and keep off the breakwaters
checklist.detail: Smoking is not allowed on Barcelona's beaches. Walking on the breakwaters, fishing from them or diving from them is forbidden. Sea conditions are shown by the beach flags.
checklist.check: Check the flag colour and swim near a lifeguard before you go in.

sources.quote: Smoking is not allowed on Barcelona’s beaches.
It is forbidden to walk on the breakwaters, fish from them or climb up on them to dive back into the water.

checklist.title: Report a theft online, then sign it at a station within 72 hours
checklist.detail: The Mossos d'Esquadra, Catalonia's police, take online reports for petty theft and lost belongings, but not for violent crime. After an online report you must go to a police station within 72 hours to sign it. For any emergency call 112, which is free and works without a SIM card.
checklist.check: Save 112 in your phone and keep your online report number to show at the station.

sources.quote: if you report a crime online, you must go to any police station to sign and complete your police report. The time frame to do this is 72 hours upon completion of the online report.
call 112. It is free, available 24 hours a day and works even without credit or a SIM card.

checklist.title: Hungary uses the forint, not the euro
checklist.detail: The currency is the forint (HUF). Some places in Budapest take euros where a sign is posted, but the exchange rate may not be very competitive.
checklist.check: Plan to pay in forints, and do not change money with unofficial moneychangers.

sources.quote: The currency in Hungary is the forint (HUF). Euros are accepted in Budapest and some other major cities where a sign is posted. Rates may not be very competitive.
Don’t use unofficial moneychangers.

checklist.title: A restaurant service charge must be on the menu
checklist.detail: Restaurants may add a service charge, but they must show it on the menu and other price lists. The service charge printed on your receipt can be at most 15 percent.
checklist.check: Read the menu for a service charge line before you order, and check the bill so you do not tip twice.

sources.publisher: Hungarian Government (kormany.hu), Ministry for National Economy
sources.quote: Az általuk alkalmazott díj mértékét − a maximált értékig − továbbra is a szolgáltatók állapíthatják meg, azt fel kell tüntetniük az étlapon és az egyéb tájékoztatási felületeiken.

sources.publisher: National Tax and Customs Administration of Hungary (NAV)
sources.quote: Fontos, hogy a vendégnek átadott bizonylaton továbbra is legfeljebb 15 százalék felszolgálási díj szerepeltethető.

checklist.title: Real Budapest taxis are yellow with a fixed official fare
checklist.detail: Licensed taxis are yellow, have yellow number plates and the words qualified Budapest taxi on the front left door. The official fare is the same at all times of day and for all operators, and you can pay by cash or card.
checklist.check: Order your taxi by app or phone from a licensed company and only get into a car with these markings.

sources.quote: Budapest taxis have standardised signage: the cars are yellow with the words "qualified Budapest taxi/minősített budapesti taxi" on the left-side front door, the number plates are yellow
The official price is the same at all times of the day and for all operators. You can pay in taxis with cash, physical and digital bankcards.

checklist.title: Airport taxis add a 2,100 forint airport base fare
checklist.detail: Since August 2026 a taxi to or from Budapest Airport starts with an airport base fare of 2,100 forints. Főtaxi is the airport's official taxi partner, with stands at Terminals 2A and 2B.
checklist.check: Budget for the airport base fare and book at the Főtaxi stand instead of accepting a ride from someone in the arrivals hall.

sources.quote: From August 2026, an airport base fare of HUF 2,100 applies to taxi journeys to and from Budapest Liszt Ferenc International Airport.

sources.publisher: Budapest Info / Visit Budapest, official city guide 2025/2026 (PDF)
sources.quote: Főtaxi is the airport’s official partner. You can book a taxi at the Főtaxi stands located at Terminals 2A and 2B.

checklist.title: The 100E airport bus needs its own 2,500 forint ticket
checklist.detail: Bus 100E runs around the clock between the airport and Deák Ferenc tér. A normal single ticket is not valid on it; you need the 2,500 forint airport shuttle bus single ticket, which you can buy by tapping your bank card on board.
checklist.check: Buy the airport shuttle ticket or tap your card at the machine by the door as you board 100E.

sources.quote: Please note that bus line 100E Airport Express is to be used only with the 2,500 HUF Airport shuttle bus single ticket or the add-on airport shuttlebus single ticket
The bus service operates around the clock, seven days a week

checklist.title: Validate paper tickets before the metro line
checklist.detail: On the metro the validators stand at the station entrance, and crossing that line with an unstamped ticket can already get you fined. On buses, trams and trolleybuses you stamp the ticket right after boarding.
checklist.check: Stamp your ticket at the metro entrance or as soon as you board, and keep it until the end of the trip.

sources.quote: Please note that the row of machines is also a platform boundary line: if you cross this line without a ticket or a non-validated ticket, you can already be fined!
On buses, trams or trolley buses, you must validate your ticket immediately after boarding.

checklist.title: Riding without a valid ticket costs 30,000 forints
checklist.detail: Inspectors issue a penalty fare of 30,000 forints. It drops to 15,000 forints if you pay in forint cash on the spot, and you must get a receipt. Hungary may refuse entry to people with an unpaid earlier fine.
checklist.check: Carry a valid ticket at all times, ask for a receipt if fined, and settle any fine before a later trip.

sources.quote: If you travel without of a valid ticket, travelcard or pass, the inspectors will issue a penalty fare cheque for 30 000 HUF. This amount is reduced to 15 000 HUF if paid in cash on the spot (only Forints are accepted.)
The sum of the on-the-spot fine will not exceed 15 000 HUF and you must be given a receipt.
Hungarian authorities may deny you entry if you’ve failed to pay a previous fine.

checklist.title: Your bank card can be your metro ticket
checklist.detail: With Budapest Pay&GO you tap a bank card or phone at the terminal at the metro entrance or on bus 100E, and that one tap buys and validates a single ticket. If an inspector checks you, tap the same card or phone again; nothing is charged.
checklist.check: Use the same card or phone for every tap, and tap once per person on the metro since it sells one ticket per tap.

sources.quote: Tap your bankcard or compatible smart device on the Pay&GO terminal as you enter the metro station, and your journey can begin. With this single gesture, you not only purchase your single ticket but also validate it.
During inspection, tap the bankcard or smart device you used to purchase your ticket against the inspector's checker. The process is secure; the device will not deduct any money during inspection.

checklist.title: Short term rentals are banned in District VI from 2026
checklist.detail: Terézváros (District VI) set the number of days a private home or other accommodation may host guests to zero from January 1, 2026. Operators who break the rule face a fine and a 45 day closure.
checklist.check: If an apartment listing is in District VI (Terézváros), book a licensed hotel instead or confirm the place is legal before you pay.

sources.quote: 2. § A magánszálláshely és az egyéb szálláshely esetében a magánszálláshelyen és az egyéb szálláshelyen az egy naptári éven belül szálláshely-szolgáltatás céljára felhasználható napok száma: 0.
7. § Ez a rendelet 2026. január 1-jén lép hatályba.

checklist.title: Legal rentals show an NTAK registration number
checklist.detail: Every accommodation advertised on a booking site in Hungary must show its NTAK registration number and its accommodation type. The authority can close unregistered places and fine them.
checklist.check: Look for the NTAK registration number on the listing and ask the host for it if it is missing.

sources.publisher: NTAK, National Tourism Data Service Centre (Hungarian Tourism Agency)
sources.quote: 2020. október 1-jétől a szálláshely-közvetítői tevékenység útján kínált szolgálatások hirdetéseiben az NTAK regisztrációs számot és a szálláshely típusát is kötelezően fel kell tüntetni.

sources.publisher: NTAK, National Tourism Data Service Centre (Hungarian Tourism Agency)
sources.quote: NTAK-ba nem regisztrált szálláshely üzemeltetését, és pénzbírságot szab ki.

checklist.title: Non EU visitors register fingerprints and a photo at the border
checklist.detail: The EU Entry/Exit System has been fully running since April 10, 2026 and replaces passport stamps. You may give fingerprints and a photo when you enter, which can mean longer waits.
checklist.check: Allow extra time at passport control on arrival and before your flight home.

sources.publisher: European Commission, Migration and Home Affairs
sources.quote: As of 10 April 2026 , the EES replaces the stamping of passports allowing the automatic detection of overstayers
when you travel into the Schengen area for short stays, you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo. There is no cost for EES registration.

checklist.title: Carry your passport; a copy is not accepted
checklist.detail: You must show ID if the police ask for it, and a photocopy does not count.
checklist.check: Keep your passport with you when you go out and leave a copy in a safe place in case it is lost.

sources.quote: Always carry your passport. You must show ID if the police ask for it, and a copy is not acceptable.
You must carry photo identification, such as your passport, at all times. Photocopies are not accepted.

checklist.title: Emergency numbers: 112, or 107 for police
checklist.detail: The general emergency number in Hungary is 112. The police number is 107.
checklist.check: Save 112 in your phone before you go.

sources.quote: general emergency assistance: 112
police: 107
Please, call the 112 emergency number.

checklist.title: A legal Paris holiday rental shows a registration number
checklist.detail: Every furnished tourist rental in Paris must be declared to the city, which gives the host a registration number. The host must show that number on every published listing.
checklist.check: Before you book an apartment, look for the Paris registration number on the listing and skip any listing that does not show one.

sources.quote: Cette déclaration obligatoire permet d’obtenir immédiatement un numéro d’enregistrement. Ce numéro doit être impérativement mentionné sur vos annonces de location publiées.

checklist.title: A host can rent out their own home for only 90 days a year
checklist.detail: If the apartment is the host's main home, Paris lets them rent it to tourists for no more than 90 days a year. A host who goes over faces a fine of up to 10,000 euros for each year.
checklist.check: If a host says the flat is their own home, ask how many nights it has already been rented this year before you pay.

sources.quote: Vous souhaitez louer votre résidence principale en meublé touristique : la limite est de 90 jours par an
Le fait de louer sa résidence principale en meublé de tourisme au-delà de 90 jours par an est sanctionné par une amende pouvant atteindre 10 000 € par année de dépassement

checklist.title: Airport taxis to central Paris have fixed fares
checklist.detail: A licensed taxi between Charles de Gaulle airport and Paris costs a flat 56 euros to the right bank or 65 euros to the left bank. From Orly it is 45 euros to the right bank or 36 euros to the left bank. No extra fees can be added to these fares.
checklist.check: Know whether your hotel is on the right or left bank and refuse any taxi that asks for more than the fixed fare.

sources.quote: Entre l'aéroport de Paris-Charles-de-Gaulle et Paris rive droite 56 € Entre l'aéroport de Paris-Charles-de-Gaulle et Paris rive gauche 65 €
Entre l'aéroport de Paris-Orly et Paris rive droite 45 € Entre l'aéroport de Paris-Orly et Paris rive gauche 36 €
Aucun frais supplémentaire ou majoration ne peut y être ajouté.

checklist.title: A single metro ticket costs 2.55 euros in 2026
checklist.detail: Since 1 January 2026, one Metro, train and RER ticket costs 2.55 euros at full fare, and a bus or tram ticket costs 2.05 euros. Buying a bus ticket on board costs 2.50 euros.
checklist.check: Budget 2.55 euros per metro or RER ride and buy your bus ticket before you board.

sources.quote: Ticket fares in Île-de-France in 2026 (normal and reduced) Occasional titles Metro-train-RER: €2.55 (€1.30) Bus-Tram: €2.05 (€1.05) Access on board: 2,50 €

checklist.title: The airport ticket costs 14 euros
checklist.detail: Trips to and from the Paris airports use a special airports ticket. It costs 14 euros at full fare and 7 euros at the reduced fare in 2026.
checklist.check: Buy the airports ticket, not a regular metro ticket, for the ride to or from CDG or Orly.

sources.quote: Tourist packages Airports ticket: 14 € (7 €)

checklist.title: The Louvre costs 32 euros if you live outside the EEA
checklist.detail: Visitors who are neither residents nor citizens of a European Economic Area country pay 32 euros. Residents and citizens of the EEA pay 22 euros.
checklist.check: Budget 32 euros per adult for the Louvre unless you are from or live in the EEA.

sources.quote: Tarif hors EEE Visiteurs non résidents et/ou non ressortissants des pays de l'Espace Economique Européen 32.00€

checklist.title: The Louvre is closed on Tuesdays and wants a booked time slot
checklist.detail: The Louvre is closed every Tuesday. The museum recommends booking a visit time online, even for visitors who get in free.
checklist.check: Do not plan the Louvre for a Tuesday and book your entry time online before you go.

sources.quote: Fermé mardi
La réservation en ligne d’un créneau de visite est recommandée, y compris pour les visiteurs bénéficiant de la gratuité

checklist.title: Eiffel Tower summit by lift costs 36.70 euros on the official site
checklist.detail: The official Eiffel Tower site is toureiffel.paris, run by the tower's operating company. There an adult summit ticket by lift costs 36.70 euros and a second floor ticket by lift costs 23.50 euros.
checklist.check: Compare any Eiffel Tower ticket price with toureiffel.paris before you pay anyone else.

sources.quote: TOUREIFFEL.PARIS LE SITE OFFICIEL DE LA TOUR EIFFEL Un site de la Société d'Exploitation de la Tour Eiffel
Sommet Billet ascenseur Adulte 36,70€
2ème étage Billet ascenseur Adulte 23,50€

checklist.title: Versailles palace entry needs a ticket with a set time
checklist.detail: The Passeport is the only ticket that lets you into the palace, and it comes with a set entry time. It costs 25 euros in low season and 35 euros in high season at the normal rate, or 22 and 32 euros for France and EEA visitors.
checklist.check: Book your Versailles Passeport and palace time slot online before the day you go.

sources.quote: C'est aussi le seul billet qui permet de visiter le château, avec un créneau horodaté.
Passeport Basse saison Haute saison Tarif normal 25 € 35 € Tarif réduit - France et Espace économique européen 22 € 32 €

checklist.title: Expect fingerprints and a photo at the border
checklist.detail: The EU Entry/Exit System has been fully running since 10 April 2026. If you are not an EU citizen, your fingerprints and face photo are taken when you enter for a short stay, and checks can take longer than before.
checklist.check: Allow extra time at passport control when you arrive and when you leave France.

sources.publisher: European Commission, Migration and Home Affairs
sources.quote: The system became fully operational on 10 April 2026.

sources.publisher: European Commission, Migration and Home Affairs
sources.quote: biometric data (fingerprints and captured facial images)
EES may take each passenger extra time to complete so be prepared to wait longer than usual at the border

checklist.title: ETIAS travel authorisation is not open yet
checklist.detail: The EU ETIAS travel authorisation is coming for visa free visitors, but applications are not open yet. When it starts, you should apply only on the official EU website.
checklist.check: Do not pay any website for an ETIAS before the EU opens applications.

sources.quote: Applications are not yet open. Apply only through the official EU website once the system is launched.

checklist.title: Call 17 for police or 112 in an emergency
checklist.detail: In Paris the police number is 17. The European emergency number 112 also works.
checklist.check: Save 17 and 112 in your phone before you travel.

sources.publisher: Préfecture de police (via French Ministry of the Interior)
sources.quote: EMERGENCY NUMBERS • police : 17 • European emergency number : 112

checklist.title: You can report some thefts online, but the service may be down
checklist.detail: France lets victims of theft by an unknown person file a complaint online. On 16 November 2026 the online complaint service said it was under maintenance, so you may need to go to a police station.
checklist.check: If something is stolen, try the online complaint first and go to the nearest police station if it is not working.

sources.quote: La plainte en ligne est proposée pour les faits d 'atteinte aux biens , comme les vols ou les dégradations, dont l' auteur est inconnu .
Les services Plainte en ligne, Visioplainte et Perceval sont actuellement en maintenance et indisponibles.

checklist.title: Prague uses the koruna, so pay cards in koruna
checklist.detail: Czechia's currency is the Czech koruna (CZK), not the euro. When a card machine or ATM offers to charge you in your home currency, the extra fees often make that option more expensive.
checklist.check: Before you go, set up a card with low foreign fees and plan to choose koruna whenever a terminal asks.

sources.quote: The currency of Czechia is the Czech koruna (CZK).
If you pay in your home currency, you know immediately exactly how much you will be charged. The extra fees often make this option more expensive.

checklist.title: You can cancel a cash exchange within 3 hours
checklist.detail: Czech law lets you cancel an exchange at the same exchange office within three hours, for free and without a reason, for up to the equivalent of 1,000 euros. For exchange machines the limit is three working days.
checklist.check: Keep your exchange receipt and check the amount you got right away, so you can return to the same office in time if the rate was bad.

sources.quote: The customer may withdraw from an exchange contract within three hours after the execution of the exchange transaction in the bureau de change where the exchange transaction was executed
Stornovat lze obchod do výše v přepočtu 1 000 EUR
he may withdraw from the exchange contract within three working days of the date of the exchange transaction

checklist.title: Exchange offices may not charge a fee, so compare both rates
checklist.detail: Charging a fee for a currency exchange is banned, except for coins or cheques. Each office sets its own rates, so a big gap between its buy and sell rate is a warning sign. The office must give you a receipt.
checklist.check: Read the rate board before handing over cash, compare the buy and sell columns, and insist on a receipt.

sources.quote: Účtovat úplatu za provedení směnárenského obchodu je zakázáno. Výjimkou může být směna mincí nebo šeků.
Před směnou si vždy porovnejte nákupní a prodejní kurz směnárny
Po provedení směny trvejte na vydání dokladu („účtenky“) o provedené směně, směnárna je povinna vám jej vydat.

checklist.title: Book the airport taxi through the official Uber Airport service
checklist.detail: Uber Airport is the official taxi service at Prague Airport, booked in the Uber app, at kiosks or at counters in the arrivals hall, and it shows the total fare before you confirm. Metered taxi fares in Prague have had no maximum since 1 October 2026, and a typical airport to centre fare is around 800 CZK.
checklist.check: Decide before you land how you will get into town, and use a service that shows the full fare in advance.

sources.quote: To book your ride, you can use the Uber app , self-service kiosks, or the counters in the arrivals hall.
The official Uber Airport service shows the total fare before you confirm your booking.
A typical fare from Prague Airport to the city centre (approx. 20 km) is around CZK 800 / EUR 32 .

checklist.title: Transport tickets are cheaper in the PID Litacka app
checklist.detail: A 90 minute ticket costs 46 CZK in the PID Litacka app and 50 CZK on paper; a 24 hour ticket is 140 CZK in the app and 150 CZK on paper. The 24 and 72 hour tickets do not cover the Airport Express AE bus.
checklist.check: Install the PID Litacka app before your trip, and buy a separate ticket if you plan to take the AE bus.

sources.quote: 30 min. 36 CZK 39 CZK 90 min. 46 CZK 50 CZK 24 hours 140 CZK 150 CZK 72 hours 340 CZK 350 CZK
Can be used on PID trams, subway, buses, ferries, trains in Prague, except for vintage routes K, 41, 42 and Airport express AE.

checklist.title: Stamp paper tickets once, or risk a 1,200 CZK fine
checklist.detail: Stamp a paper ticket when you board a tram or bus or enter the metro, and do not stamp it again when you change, because restamping makes it invalid. Since 1 January 2026 riding without a valid ticket in Prague costs 1,200 CZK paid on the spot, 1,500 CZK within 15 days, or 2,000 CZK otherwise.
checklist.check: Learn the stamping rule before you ride, and keep the ticket until you leave the vehicle or station.

sources.quote: Don’t forget to stamp your ticket upon entering the vehicle (tram, bus, ferry) or the transport space (metro and funicular) in the stamping device, otherwise you risk incurring a fine .
When transferring, do not stamp the ticket again. Restamping invalidates the ticket!
Přirážka za jízdu bez platného jízdního dokladu: 1 200 Kč (na místě) 1 500 Kč (do 15 dnů) 2 000 Kč (ostatní případy)

checklist.title: No drinking in public in the centre, and quiet after 10 pm
checklist.detail: Drinking alcohol in public in the city centre is forbidden. Night time quiet hours start at 10 pm, and the city says the fine for disturbing the peace is 400 euros.
checklist.check: If you are planning a group or party trip, plan to drink inside bars, not on the street.

sources.quote: It is forbidden to drink alcohol in public in the city centre.
After 10 pm, the night-time quiet hours apply.
The fine for disturbing the peace is 400 euros.

checklist.title: Carry your passport at all times
checklist.detail: Carrying ID is a legal requirement in Czechia and police can ask for it at any time. The police may fine or arrest you if you do not have it.
checklist.check: Pack your passport for daily use and keep a digital copy somewhere safe.

sources.quote: It is a legal requirement to carry ID. Always carry your passport. The police may fine or arrest you if you do not.
Local police may ask for your identification at any time.

checklist.title: Your address must be registered within 3 days
checklist.detail: Visitors without a Czech residence permit must register their address with the foreign police within 3 days of arriving. Hotels and other commercial stays usually do it for you; if you skip it, the fine can reach 3,000 koruna.
checklist.check: If you book a private stay, ask the host before booking whether they will register you, and if not, plan a visit to the foreign police.

sources.quote: you must register your address with the nearest foreign police department (in Czech) within 3 days of arriving. You can also register through your hotel or accommodation service.
If you do not register, you could get a fine of up to 3,000 Czech koruna.
Commercial accommodations will generally complete the registration on your behalf. Make sure they do so.

checklist.title: Expect fingerprints and a photo at the border under EES
checklist.detail: Since 10 April 2026 the EU Entry/Exit System has replaced passport stamps for non EU short stay visitors and records fingerprints and a face image. It costs nothing, but it can add time at the border, including when you leave.
checklist.check: Allow extra time at the airport on arrival and departure, and check your passport is under 10 years old and valid 3 months past your exit.

sources.publisher: European Commission, Migration and Home Affairs
sources.quote: As of 10 April 2026 , the EES replaces the stamping of passports allowing the automatic detection of overstayers
There is no cost for EES registration.
If you are departing the Schengen area by plane, allow extra time to reach your departure gate as EES checks may take place before boarding.

checklist.title: ETIAS is not running yet, so do not pay anyone for it
checklist.detail: The EU travel authorisation ETIAS is not in operation and no applications are being taken. When it starts, the fee will be 20 euros and you should apply only through the official EU website.
checklist.check: Ignore websites selling ETIAS approvals now, and check the official EU site again before future trips.

sources.publisher: European Commission, Migration and Home Affairs
sources.quote: The European Travel Information and Authorisation System (ETIAS) is currently not in operation and no applications for travel authorisations are collected at this point.

sources.publisher: European Commission, Migration and Home Affairs
sources.quote: ETIAS fee has been set at EUR 20 instead of the previous EUR 7.
Apply only through the official EU website once the system is launched.

checklist.title: Prague Castle tickets cost 450 CZK and last 2 days
checklist.detail: A basic Prague Castle ticket costs 450 CZK, a family ticket 950 CZK. Tickets are valid for 2 days, but you can enter each building only once. Tickets are sold at the castle information centres, and the castle names GetYourGuide as its online partner for the Main circuit.
checklist.check: Plan which buildings you want to see before you buy, and buy only from the castle desks or the partner it names.

sources.quote: admission basic 450 CZK reduced 300 CZK family 950 CZK
Tickets are valid for 2 days. You may enter each building only once with a valid ticket.
Tickets for the circuits can be purchased in the information centres in the Prague Castle.
Online tickets for the Main circuit can be also purchased online through the GetYourGuide ticketing network here.

checklist.title: Report a theft in person within 24 hours
checklist.detail: Thefts should be reported in person at a police station within 24 hours to get a crime number for insurance. The station at Jungmannovo namesti 9 near Mustek metro is open 24 hours with English interpreters. Lampposts carry a 6 digit number you can give the police as your location.
checklist.check: Save 112 and the police station address in your phone before you go.

sources.quote: Report thefts in person to the nearest Czech police station within 24 hours and get a police report crime number for insurance purposes.
Prague police station (Jungmannovo namesti 9, Prague 1, nearest metro stop is Mustek) is open 24 hours a day and would provide English speaking interpreters.
Every lamppost in Prague has a 6-digit number posted at eye level.
Telephone: 112 (ambulance, fire, police)
